'''Entangle''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell could be used to control nearby [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life to ensnare a target. Ascendants needed to known the [[psychokinesis]] spell to learn the entangle spell.
